# The Pipe Will Climb the Hill

It is official: the Great Sanitation Works will resume, and the trunk line that has stopped three streets above Vila Tamarin for eight years is to be finished. On the slopes, nobody is celebrating yet. "We celebrated in October," said a woman who sells lunch at the dock gate. "They put up a sign." The Voice will be on the hill on the day the first new pipe goes in. So, we hope, will the President.
